text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the tryouts is here,
but I can't stop thinking about what
T.M. Opera O
said. If only I could understand her
reasoning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll be able to find out at the
race.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Your desire to see me won out at
last.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then I'd be overjoyed to show you!
Watch my race and be
amazed!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but look now. My rivals have ventured
forth in the midst of our
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Oppy! I'm super excited to race
today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I, uh... I w-won't do well,
but... I'll try really
hard!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
What fine spirits you're both in! I
look forward to a
magnificently fierce bout
between us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the fateful tryouts begin!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This glory... shall be mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's such a close race that anyone could
seize it. As the finish draws
near, T.M.
Opera O pulls ahead, and...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Barely, just barely, she takes first.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... So close,
but... I couldn't make it...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... You two were so fast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet, despite the win, Opera O looks
so... sullen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Impressive... To you,
perhaps. But not I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, what's the matter with Oppy?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, uh, maybe she didn't win the way
she wanted to?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... This is just my own thought, and the
truth might be a little
different... No, I'm
sure I'm totally off...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But Opera O...
She sets really high bars all
the time. I learn a lot from
her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She's always saying, "My dignity as
Overlord is at stake!" Her heart's
really in
it, you know? So winning by a tiny lead
isn't quite, um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her "dignity as Overlord..." I think I get
why she looked so
uncharacteristically sad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't just want to win races. She
wants to stand tall, true to her
name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to shake my concern, I chase after
Opera O, and when I catch
up, the sky's
overcast with dark clouds.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, you found me...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, do you prefer a sunny sky or a
cloudy one?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I favor one filled with sunlight.
The shine
of the radiant sun fills
people with
bravery, you see.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you about my dreams. Ah, but
to tell the whole story, we
must travel into
the past...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When I was a young child, I once became
lost in a gigantic forest.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of those dark woods, I had
not an inkling of my whereabouts... I'll
always remember feeling as if I was the
last person
in the world.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But then... Oh, I was bestowed with a great blessing! For that was the place where I met her...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who would change my
destiny!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... In the deepest depths of that
surreal forest, I found her in a
spring of
sweet water.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She smiled up at me from the water's
crystal clear surface and told me
that all
would work out in the end.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She had the mightiest presence in the
world... The most beautiful... I
was moved
to my very soul!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think that such a resplendent being had
existed in this wide world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you understand now! The
Umamusume gazing up at me from the

water was my very own reflection!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I was stunned as if struck by the
lightning
of epiphany! Before that, I
was ignorant of
my own hope-inspiring brilliance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I were to truly become a lord
absolute...
how astoundingly bright
the light of the
Centurial Overlord would be!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I would become nothing less than the sun,
which bathes the whole
world in its
warmth!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I must become that! I must be the sun of Umamusume that brings prosperity to all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm more confused than ever...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I see at least that she's serious
about
taking on the title of
Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What's this?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, behold! The heavens have opened!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The light that shines forth... That is the
supreme radiance I will
achieve!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now is not the time to mope about.
The Overlord must train for
her next
victory!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O sun! Praise be to you for showing me the
light! Hahaha! Haaah ha
ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While T.M. Opera O is preoccupied with
the sun on high, all I see is
the twinkling
light of hope in her eyes.
